caption_L1: This bar chart is called Number of plants of selected leading cement producers worldwide in 2017. A linear scale of range 0 to 200 can be found along the y-axis, marked Number of plants. There is a categorical scale starting at Buzzi Unicem (italy) and ending at Votorantim (Brazil) along the x-axis, marked Company (country).
caption_L2L3: Nigeria has the least number of cement producing plants in 2017, whilst Switzerland has the highest. The highest concentration of cement producing plants in 2017 were based in Europe.
